item.title: When the Internet Runs Through Space, Operators Are Left with Local Services
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers When the Internet Runs Through Space, Operators Are Left with Local Services According to the published roadmaps of the largest satellite operators, it’s a matter of two years or less: **orbital data centers from late 2027 and direct-to-mobile satellite service in 2028.**¹ Meanwhile, almost everything stays the same. Traditional operators keep investing in 5G and 6G as if nothing were about to change. When those plans are executed, the impact on the traditional model will be severe.
